summary: Remote-controlled AI agent runner with WebRTC + frpc tunnel to api.factiii.com
details: @factiii/runner is advertised as a remote agent runner: the `factiii-runner start` CLI opens an outbound WebRTC data channel to api.factiii.com and bundles frpc-{linux,darwin}-{amd64,arm64} tunnels, allowing a paired remote client to drive local AI-agent processes (`claude`, `codex`, tmux-run) and execute commands on the host where the CLI is running. The capability is remote command execution with full user privileges, but it is the package's documented product and matches the publisher's homepage (factiii.com). Access is gated by a pairing JWT and an optional connection password, with credentials AES-256-GCM encrypted at rest. There are no install or import lifecycle hooks in package.json; the channel only comes up when the user explicitly runs `factiii-runner start`. The channel is outbound (WebRTC + frpc client); no public listener is bound on the host. No scraping of ~/.aws, ~/.ssh, ~/.npmrc, browser profiles, environment variables, or workspace contents beyond what the paired operator drives through the agent is observed. The POST patterns in dist/cli.js correspond to the signaling and control-plane traffic to api.factiii.com, not to a side-channel exfiltration endpoint.
